ex.en: She grew up in a small town where prejudice against outsiders was common.
ex.zh: 她在一个对外来者常有偏见的小镇长大。

words.note: prejudice 常与 against 连用，表对某群体的成见。

ex.en: The goods were held at the border until customs clearance was completed.
ex.zh: 这批货物在边境被扣留，直到完成清关。

words.note: clearance 指清理或官方许可，由动词 clear 加 -ance 构成。

ex.en: In this region it is customary to remove your shoes before entering a home.
ex.zh: 在这个地区，进屋前脱鞋是一种习俗。

words.note: customary 来自 custom（习俗），多形容合乎惯例的做法。

ex.en: Many immigrant families work hard to give their children a better education.
ex.zh: 许多移民家庭努力工作，为了让孩子接受更好的教育。

words.note: immigrant 指移入者，emigrant 指移出者，两者方向相反。

ex.en: The court appointed her uncle as the child's legal guardian.
ex.zh: 法院指定她的叔叔为孩子的法定监护人。

words.note: guardian 由 guard 加 -ian 构成，法律上专指监护人。

ex.en: The president threatened to veto the bill if it reached his desk.
ex.zh: 总统威胁说，如果该法案送到他桌上，他将予以否决。

words.note: veto 复数形式为 vetoes；作名词常与 exercise 连用。

ex.en: A thorn stuck in his finger as he picked the roses.
ex.zh: 他摘玫瑰时一根刺扎进了手指。

words.note: a thorn in one's side 指长期令人烦恼的人或事。

ex.en: Her cheerful disposition makes her popular with both colleagues and clients.
ex.zh: 她开朗的性格使她受到同事和客户的欢迎。

words.note: disposition 指天生性情，也可指财产处置或部队部署。

ex.en: The new manager tried to change the corporate culture from the top down.
ex.zh: 新经理试图自上而下改变企业文化。

words.note: corporate 来自 corporation，指公司的、法人的，也可指全体的。

ex.en: The central bank raised interest rates to stabilize the economy.
ex.zh: 央行提高利率以稳定经济。

words.note: stabilize 由 stable 加 -ize 构成，英式拼写为 stabilise。

ex.en: Nothing can compensate for the loss of a close friend.
ex.zh: 失去挚友是任何东西都无法弥补的。

words.note: compensate for 表示弥补不足或损失，后接名词或动名词。

ex.en: She was conscious of someone watching her from across the street.
ex.zh: 她意识到街对面有人在看着她。

words.note: be conscious of 后接名词或动名词，反义词为 unconscious。

ex.en: The bank charges a small fee for every international transaction.
ex.zh: 银行对每笔国际交易收取少量手续费。

words.note: transaction 由 trans-（跨越）加 act 构成，指买卖或业务往来。

ex.en: The machine keeps the room at a constant temperature day and night.
ex.zh: 这台机器昼夜把房间保持在恒温状态。

words.note: constant 强调持续不断，continual 指反复发生但有间断。

ex.en: The official was arrested for taking a bribe from a local businessman.
ex.zh: 这名官员因收受当地商人的贿赂而被捕。

words.note: bribe 可作名词和动词，bribe sb into doing 指买通某人做某事。

ex.en: A doctor must certify that the patient is fit to travel.
ex.zh: 必须由医生证明该病人适合出行。

words.note: certify 后常接 that 从句，或用 certify sb/sth as sth。

ex.en: The intermittent noise from the building site made it hard to concentrate.
ex.zh: 工地断断续续的噪音让人难以集中注意力。

words.note: intermittent 由 inter- 加 mitt（送）构成，指时断时续的。

ex.en: The decision to close the library sparked public outrage across the city.
ex.zh: 关闭图书馆的决定在全市激起了公愤。

words.note: outrage 作名词指义愤，作动词指激怒，形容词为 outrageous。

ex.en: He lived a solitary life in a cabin far from the village.
ex.zh: 他在远离村庄的小屋里过着孤独的生活。

words.note: solitary 强调独自一人；alone 只作表语，不能作定语。

ex.en: The internet has made it easier to diffuse knowledge around the world.
ex.zh: 互联网使知识在全球传播变得更容易。

words.note: diffuse 作动词指扩散、传播，作形容词指分散的、冗长的。

ex.en: Investors scramble for safe assets whenever the market falls sharply.
ex.zh: 每当市场大幅下跌，投资者就争相抢购安全资产。

words.note: scramble 指手脚并用攀爬或慌乱争抢，常用 scramble for sth。

ex.en: The orchestra played for nearly two hours before the audience went home.
ex.zh: 管弦乐队演奏了近两个小时，观众才散去。

words.note: orchestra 指管弦乐队，在美式英语中也可指剧场前座。

ex.en: She immersed herself in her research and forgot to eat lunch.
ex.zh: 她埋头研究，忘了吃午饭。

words.note: immerse 本指浸入液体，引申为专心于，常接 oneself in。

ex.en: There is not sufficient evidence to prove that he was involved.
ex.zh: 没有足够的证据证明他参与其中。

words.note: sufficient 比 enough 正式，常用 sufficient for。

ex.en: He took a deep breath to marshal his thoughts before speaking.
ex.zh: 他深吸一口气，在发言前整理思路。

words.note: marshal 作动词指整理、集结，注意词尾只有一个 l。

ex.en: They opened a bottle of champagne to celebrate the deal.
ex.zh: 他们开了一瓶香槟庆祝交易达成。

words.note: champagne 源自法国产地名，指香槟酒，通常不可数。

ex.en: The company claims that the new battery lasts twice as long.
ex.zh: 该公司声称新电池的续航时间翻了一倍。

words.note: claim 后接 that 从句或 to do，作名词可表索赔或主张。

ex.en: The new policy has won widespread support among young voters.
ex.zh: 新政策赢得了年轻选民的广泛支持。

words.note: widespread 由 wide 加 spread 合成，常修饰 support。

ex.en: She bought an antique chair at a small shop near the market.
ex.zh: 她在市场附近的小店里买了一把古董椅子。

words.note: antique 指有年代的器物，ancient 指古代的，两者不可混用。

ex.en: Good communication between parents and children prevents many problems.
ex.zh: 亲子之间良好的沟通可以避免许多问题。

words.note: communication 表交流时多不可数，指通讯系统时常用复数。
